title: Peruvian Earthy Skillet
description: A flavorful and hearty dish that combines the earthy flavors of Peruvian cuisine with the simplicity of a skillet meal.
instructions: Preheat the skillet over medium heat.
Add the olive oil and sauté the onions until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the tofu and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the potatoes and cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with skillet seasoning, salt, and black pepper to taste.
Optional: garnish with chopped fresh herbs such as cilantro or scallions.
Optional: serve with a side of steamed vegetables or a simple salad.
